ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Using Windows Media Player - Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using Windows Media Player osksupport.dll (UACMe 32)

sequences.query: (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Windows\ Media\ Player\\osk\.exe" OR (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd\.exe" AND parent_process_command_line = "\"C\:\\Windows\\system32\\mmc\.exe\"\ \"C\:\\Windows\\system32\\eventvwr\.msc\"\ \/s")) AND (process_integrity_level = "High" OR process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-12288")
